scope: Final uniform execution path, static model metadata, existing live readback, LB preservation and stream hot path; independent read-only review, no Cargo invocations
verified_by_source_review: Uniform output tuple is only taken when net == Net::Walk and a validated SHA-bound sidecar is present.
Final shipped sidecar is mode uniform, action_scale .9, head_lowpass .5, legs_lowpass .7; no phase, tilt, gyro or dwell routing remains.
Contract validation requires unfiltered scale-1 VelStand training mapping, rejects unknown/duplicate fields and binds full ONNX SHA256.
Observation previous_action remains raw actor output; scale then target EMA is applied after one inference. First target passes through; later targets blend against previous commanded target.
Base scale still multiplies existing voltage adaptation. No sidecar preserves the declared joint training baseline1/1/1.
LB, Stand, SitStand, GroundPick and other named skills retain their prior routing. Main changes relative to v145 are limited to actual-filter readback success gating and scale_use joint_uniform.
Failed inference clears applied scale/filter before attempting inference; last_net changes only on success. main emits null scale/filter rather than stale previous mapping when held after error.

New profile metadata is cloned/serialized at load/model change via the existing cache; no new IMU read, UART operation, network poll, timer, high-frequency JSON metadata rebuilding or control-loop phase computation.

The final joint_uniform_tests.rs includes real-ONNX checks for posture-invariant fixed values, raw action feedback, final target arithmetic, no-sidecar baseline, reload/reset, independent LB return and failed inference readback.
limitations: Source review and UI/codec regressions do not establish physical get-up success, thermal improvement or onboard timing.
Native tests were run by the implementation agent; this reviewer did not rerun Cargo or operate robot hardware.
